unit_of_analysis: one patient row; cross-sectional, not longitudinal

configuration.control_axis_policy: each eligible numeric source column gets one separate run
configuration.flux_policy: all other numeric source columns are mapped as separate fluxes
configuration.nonmonotone_controls: retained; monotonicity recorded as a diagnostic
configuration.categorical_columns: not numerically recoded; separate categorical companion analysis remains unchanged
configuration.row_order_sensitivity: source, reverse, and one fixed seeded permutation; no row is a time point
configuration.interpretation_boundary: descriptive analysis only; no temporal, causal, predictive, diagnostic, or treatment-efficacy claim
